n: Sphero in PE dance unit (Vancouver SD)
t: Students code a Sphero robot in PE and use it as a dance partner.
steps: Find the Vancouver Public Schools article and the EdTech Magazine article by Sam Patterson.
Install the programming app on a school tablet.
Pair the Sphero with the tablet.
Clear a safe space in the gym.
Have students code a short dance move.
Let classmates follow the coded instructions.
